title: the opt-in post-tool advisory hands the model a clean critic run's output, because its empty-output test never fires
body:
Found by cc's templates audit on 2026-09-24 for the 3.2.1 doc audit; measured by cc.

Seen: `lib/templates/.claude/scripts/post-tool-advisory.sh:82-83` tests `[ -z "$findings" ]` to stay quiet on a clean run, and that test never fires, because `intent critic` always prints its census -- a clean run prints three lines at rc 0. So with the opt-in advisory switched on, every Write or Edit hands the model a clean run's output.

Expected: a clean critic run adds nothing to the model's context.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- low, filed for after the stabilisation line; the advisory is opt-in.
